Title: 499070-2026: France – Construction work for the renewal of bridges – Rehabilitation of the Vaucresson bridge
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Refurbishment of a road bridge over the motorway with a complex structural situation (cantilever-like bearings, severe concrete and reinforcement damage) is highly relevant for sbp; complex planning and execution contract with competitive dialogue increases relevance. Location in France slightly reduces priority compared to DACH projects.
kurzbeschreibung: Complex refurbishment of a road bridge over the A13 motorway in a competitive dialogue procedure.
umfang: Refurbishment of a road bridge of the RD182 over the A13 motorway at junction 5, built in 1937. The bridge deck has a special design with cantilever bearings. Significant damage is reported, including concrete damage and advanced corrosion of the reinforcement. The aim is structural renewal or rehabilitation under ongoing traffic conditions, optimising traffic-free periods and possible motorway closures. No information is given on spans, width or areas.
leistungen: Planning and construction execution under a design-build contract with a preceding competitive dialogue; concept design, technical studies, detailed design and construction works for the bridge refurbishment.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Road bridge with complex existing structure and demanding refurbishment task fits well with sbp's competencies in bridge construction.
• Explicitly tendered as a design-and-build contract with competitive dialogue; this provides relevant early planning involvement.
• Special structural concept with cantilever bearings and significant existing damage and deterioration increases the technical relevance.
• Price is not the sole award criterion, but weighted at only 40 percent; technical quality predominates.
• Project in France is geographically generally suitable for sbp Europe.
• Slightly lower relevance as no large spans or iconic new-build qualities are mentioned and it is a refurbishment in a construction contract format.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the tender. For a reliable estimate, key parameters such as span, width, traffic management, depth of intervention, replacement share of the superstructure and construction phases are missing. Based on the described complex refurbishment of a motorway overpass with traffic phases and possible closure logistics, a mid single- to double-digit million amount would be conceivable, but not sufficiently reliable.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee explicitly stated. As this is a combined contract for planning and construction in a design-build model, a separate fee for structural design or sbp cannot be derived from the notice.
referenzen_qualifikationen: The names and professional qualifications of the personnel deployed for the performance of the contract must be indicated in the tender. Further specific reference requirements are set out in the procurement documents and are not detailed in the notice.
auftraggeber: Département des Hauts-de-Seine, Hôtel du Département des Hauts-de-Seine, 57 rue des longues raies, 92000 Nanterre, France. Contact person: Siffredi Georges. E-mail: cellulecontact.achats@hauts-de-seine.fr. Website: https://achats.hauts-de-seine.fr/
notes: Procedure type: competitive dialogue. Duration 30 months from 16.07.2027. Electronic submission required. French is the language of the procedure. Possibility of similar follow-up contracts within 3 years according to the contract conditions.
